_format: Each opening is a list of [x, y] pairs (x = column, y = row, 0-based; converted with game.xy_to_move). Moves alternate Black, White, Black, ... starting with Black. All 10 openings are 4 quiet moves near the centre — no immediate threats, no five-in-a-row possible with 2 stones per side. Pre-registered for ML batch 4's vs-v8 legs (see research/ml-batch-4-plan.md): game i uses openings[i % 10], so each opening is played 10 times across a 100-game leg, 5 per colour.
